record.summary: Passive.GLISCOR has no PassiveEffects entry. Its only reader is a branch inside Status.updatePoison: while the unit is poisoned the once-per-second poison tick uses (poisonStacks - 2) instead of poisonStacks as the multiplier of 5% of maxHP. With 1 stack the multiplier is -1, so the tick requests a heal of round(0.05 x maxHP) (after the shared modifiers) through handleHeal(self, apBoost 0, no crit) instead of damage; with 2 stacks it is 0 and nothing happens; with 3 stacks it takes 1x (5% maxHP) as TRUE damage, with 4 stacks (origin VENOMOUS) 2x and with 5 (origin TOXIC) 3x. The rain x0.7, Assault Vest x0.5, Toxic Boost x0.5 and Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer multipliers run after this branch and therefore also shrink the (negative) heal request; the result is rounded once, then negated for the heal. The requested heal is then subject to handleHeal (core-mechanics section J2): a wounded unit gets 0 (plus the Blood Moon / Blood Stone addShield request of round(0.3 x stones x requested heal)), status.protect gives 0 (Rune Protect alone does not), burning and enraged halve it, ZENITH weather x1.2, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, then the missing-HP cap; Grass overheal becomes addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal). Damage ticks (3+ stacks) go through handleDamage as TRUE damage with a floor of 1, so Armor/Special Defense do not apply but shields and Protect do (section J1).
triggers: poison application (triggerPoison) adds one stack; transferNegativeStatus adds one stack to the receiver

effects.declaredRaw: poison tick multiplier = stacks - 2 (instead of stacks) of 0.05 x maxHP
effects.scaling: requested amount = 0.05 x maxHP x (stacks - 2), then x0.7 rain / x0.5 Assault Vest / x0.5 Toxic Boost / x0.7 Swift Swim or x0.5 Hydration or x0.3 Water Veil, Surge Surfer, then Math.round (JS rounding: .5 rounds toward +infinity, so a negative -2.5 becomes -2)
effects.resolution: requested only: 1 stack -> heal request round(|value|); 2 stacks -> 0 (no heal, no damage); >=3 stacks -> TRUE damage request. Stacks cap at 3 (4 VENOMOUS origin, 5 TOXIC origin), so the strongest damage tick is 1x/2x/3x of 5% maxHP.

effects.declaredRaw: requested heal = round(-poisonDamage) when poisonDamage < 0 (only possible with exactly 1 stack)
effects.scaling: caster = the unit itself, apBoost 0, crit false: AP and crit power do not apply; the amount is the requested value, not the applied one
effects.resolution: applied heal is decided by handleHeal (section J2): wound -> 0 (plus Blood Stone shield request round(0.3 x stones x requested) under Blood Moon, recipient = caster); status.protect -> 0 (Rune Protect alone does not block); modifiers burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3 then round; capped to missing HP; overheal on a GRASS-synergy unit adds addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal). healDone credit goes to the unit itself.

effects.declaredRaw: 3+ stacks: min 1 TRUE damage of round(0.05 x maxHP x (stacks - 2) x modifiers), attacker = poisonOrigin
effects.scaling: requested amount only; Armor/Special Defense not applied (TRUE); takenDamage includes shield damage (section J1) so applied HP loss can be lower than requested
